narrative.overview: The site sits at night on deep water. Surfaces are stepped navy over a fixed field of faint wave lines. One ocean-blue accent carries every action; a colder cyan whitewater breaks the surface only for emphasis. Depth is tonal before it is shadowed, and glow is reserved for the primary call to action. Components are composed and technical.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, tonal navy surfaces; hairline borders instead of heavy outlines
One blue accent for action; cyan whitewater for emphasis only
Space Grotesk throughout with JetBrains Mono for indices and metadata
Fixed wave-line backdrop masked to fade by about 85% of the viewport
Full-bleed sections with 90px vertical padding and a 48px side gutter

rules.name: The Single Beacon Rule
rules.body: Ocean is the only colour that means "act". Never use it for decoration, and never introduce a second action colour.

rules.name: The Whitewater Rule
rules.body: Cyan appears at most once or twice per viewport, as emphasis on a word or figure.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a blue-shifted ink. No pure black, no neutral gray, no pure white.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels sit above a heading and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Hero subtitle caps at 640px, headings at 820px, inner-page body at 760px.

rules.name: The Rare Glow Rule
rules.body: Only the primary call to action glows. If two glows share a viewport, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Hairline-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated first by a tonal step and a hairline; the shadow is added only to settle it.

dos: Do use tonal steps and a 1px hairline to separate surfaces before reaching for a shadow.
Do keep Ocean (#2563eb) for actions only.
Do use Whitewater for one word or figure per viewport.
Do build with the CSS custom properties from the token files.
Do keep inner-page content in a narrow 760px column.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion for the page fade and card lift.
donts: Don't add a light theme, or any pure white or pure black surface.
Don't introduce a second action colour, gradient text, or decorative glows outside the primary button.
Don't use uppercase tracked text outside eyebrows and section labels.
Don't put a shadow without a hairline on a card, or a heavy 2px outline on a container.
Don't let the wave backdrop sit under body text at full strength.
